Charizard.name: Bellyzard
Charizard.label: Belly Drum sweeper
Charizard.description: Maxes its Attack with Belly Drum behind a Substitute, then sweeps after its Salac Berry kicks in.

Heracross.name: Endure Reversal
Heracross.label: Reversal attacker
Heracross.description: Endures a hit to drop to 1 HP, then its Salac Berry and full-power Reversal take over.

Blaziken.name: Swords Dance Reversal
Blaziken.label: Reversal attacker
Blaziken.description: Boosts with Swords Dance, Endures to 1 HP, then hits back with Reversal after its Salac Berry.

Snorlax.name: Belly Drum
Snorlax.label: Belly Drum sweeper
Snorlax.description: Maxes its Attack in one turn and tries to bulldoze through with Return.

Smeargle.name: Belly Drum Extreme Speed
Smeargle.label: Belly Drum sweeper
Smeargle.description: Puts a foe to sleep, Belly Drums behind a Substitute, then sweeps with priority Extreme Speed.

Swampert.name: Curse
Swampert.label: Curse sweeper
Swampert.description: Stacks Curse boosts and heals with Rest, turning its bulk into a slow, heavy sweep.

Tyranitar.name: Special Tyranitar
Tyranitar.label: Special attacker
Tyranitar.description: Surprises its usual counters with special Crunch, Fire Blast, Thunderbolt, and Ice Beam.

Lapras.name: Dragon Dance
Lapras.label: Dragon Dance sweeper
Lapras.description: Boosts its Attack and Speed with Dragon Dance, then sweeps with a bulky body behind it.

Marowak.name: Belly Drum
Marowak.label: Belly Drum sweeper
Marowak.description: Doubles its huge Thick Club Attack again with Belly Drum, then swings for the knockout.

Gyarados.name: Taunt Dragon Dance
Gyarados.label: Dragon Dance sweeper
Gyarados.description: Taunts walls so they can't stop it, Dragon Dances, then sweeps.

Gengar.name: Hypnosis Destiny Bond
Gengar.label: Sleep lead
Gengar.description: Puts a foe to sleep, then takes an attacker down with it using Destiny Bond.

Electrode.name: Screen lead
Electrode.label: Screen lead
Electrode.description: Taunts the foe's lead, sets Light Screen for the team, then Explodes.

Kingdra.name: Dragon Dance
Kingdra.label: Dragon Dance sweeper
Kingdra.description: Boosts with Dragon Dance and hits hard on both sides with Hydro Pump and Hidden Power Flying.

Scizor.name: Agility Reversal
Scizor.label: Reversal attacker
Scizor.description: Speeds up with Agility, Endures to 1 HP, then sweeps with Reversal after its Liechi Berry.

Misdreavus.name: Imprison
Misdreavus.label: Imprison support
Misdreavus.description: Seals off any move it shares with the foe, so attackers relying on Thunderbolt or Hidden Power go quiet.
